lead: The list menu: a title, a line of context and a trailing arrow, ruled between. Thirty rows cost the page a fraction of what thirty cards would, which is the entire reason to choose it.

items.title: The whole row is the link
items.description: Not the title alone — a row is one destination and one target

items.title: A row without a description collapses
The arrow is drawn, not fetched
items.description: Two borders on an empty box, hidden from assistive technology

items.title: Compact tightens the rows
items.description: The toggle changes the padding and nothing else about the row

items.title: Up to thirty destinations
items.description: Past that the list wants columns, which is the Section Index
